notes.title: SINce Memories: Off The Starry Sky OUT NOW!
notes.content:
SINce Memories: Off the Starry Sky is out now on Steam! 

[b]Watch the Launch Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=Q5OzNSq_s_g;full][/previewyoutube]

Follow the story of Junya, lost in his own world but soft-hearted and ready to help those in need, his close friends try to keep him grounded following the tragic loss of his brother. As Junya tries to move forward from his grief, focusing on his studies and his work, he loses himself deep in trying to help others.
 
Whether he's turning a Japanese manor house into a café, or solving the mystery of his brother's death - Junya's life is inexorably linked to the women around him. Only by deepening his relationships with them can he solve their interwoven problems - and through that, find peace himself.
 
With Japanese voice over, vivid artwork which brings the story to life, and a moving story, this coming-of-age visual novel takes you on a journey of growth, love and healing - with surprises at every turn.
